verdict.rationale: Exa documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. It has a complete setup guide for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and 10+ other clients, and exposes web search, fetching, code search, Exa Agent and Exa Connect tools. It is open source, needs no API key to start, supports OAuth or API-key auth, and ships as an official OpenAI plugin. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Tool-using agents can call Exa without writing code through the hosted MCP server at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
Complete setup guide for Exa MCP Server. Connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and 10+ AI assistants to Exa's web search, fetching, Exa Agent, and Exa Connect tools.
No API key is required to get started. Exa MCP is open source and available on GitHub.
Exa is an official plugin in OpenAI's plugin directory, which includes the hosted MCP server plus Exa's `search` and `exa-agent` skills.
Connect with OAuth or your API key and the `agent_run` tool is enabled by default, so you can run multi-step research, list-building, enrichment
